items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Interviewer mentions Albert Walters in a list of people present ('with Danny and Louise and, uh, and, uh, Albert Walters'), but the Interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship or interaction with Albert Walters.

ctx.x: Yeah, we, we could, we could have been arrested when we were, uh, playing at that place on bourbon, at 1111 bourbon, I don't know, with Danny and Louise and, uh, and, uh, Albert Walters. Well, here they didn't bother you.
Yeah. Because when I worked at the Mullen Ruards, uh, I played and emceed the show for white striptease acts.
